Subject: RE: Pricing + crediting ask for compliance guardrails (audit logs / HSM)

Susan —

Appreciate the clear asks. Below is a concise worked example and three packaging options. I attached a PDF that shows the HSM amortization math.

Assumptions used for the worked numbers: 36-month term, 1M events/day ingestion baseline, 3 TB/month auditlog ingest, USD.

Option A — Pilot (12m)
- Audit log retention (90d): $0.020 per 1k events/month => projected $1,800/mo
- KMS hotpath: $1,100/mo
- HSM: One-time $45,000 install + $1,500/mo support
- Residency surcharge (US-east): +8% on addon lines
- No commit discount applied

Option B — Committed (36m) — recommended for economics
- Audit log retention (90d): $0.016 per 1k events/month => projected $1,440/mo
- KMS hotpath: $900/mo
- HSM: We offer two presentation styles: 
  1) One-time invoice: $45,000 upfront + $1,000/mo support
  2) Amortized: $1,250/mo for first 18 months then $1,000/mo maintenance after (equivalent NPV to option 1)
- Residency surcharge (US-east): +6% (we offer reduced surcharge on committed terms)
- Commit discount: 15% off addon lines when customer signs 36m commit >= $500k ARR

Option C — Enterprise (36m + evidence package)
- Audit log retention (365d): $0.025 per 1k events/month => projected $2,250/mo
- KMS hotpath: $1,200/mo
- HSM: Amortized across 36m: $1,250/mo + $800/mo maintenance after full amortization (showing blended amortization in attached PDF)
- Residency surcharge: +4% (tiered reduction)
- HIPAA evidence & SOC2 artifact bundle: one-time $8,000 (includes evidence packaging + 2 extra audit support days) — can be capitalized or treated as a one-time fee depending on procurement preference

Capex-offset model (how Redwood proposes to show it on SOW):
- We can issue a one-time implementation invoice for the HSM. Simultaneously Redwood will apply a credit schedule that reduces recurring addon charges over the first 12 months up to the invoiced amount (example: $45k one-time capex offset as a credit spread across months 1–12). Alternatively, we can present the same economics as an amortized monthly line (internal amortization). Both options have identical cash flows; GV can pick preferred invoicing language for procurement.

Next steps: 
- I attached the HSM amortization PDF and updated GV worksheet with option B populated.
- Marcus — will prepare a clean SOW for DocuSign once Susan confirms Option B.

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
(Attachments: Redwood_HSM_Seat_Amortization.pdf, GV_Proposal_Pricing_Worksheet.xlsx)
